From pm-cli PR #108 review of managed pm-changelog@2026.6.4. When --changelog-json is combined with release-window output and visibility flags such as --all-release-tags --limit 1 --suggest-semver or --since-version, the JSON releases array is narrowed through visible sections but suggestSemver(options) recomputes over filterItems(options). That can report a bump from older hidden releases not present in the emitted changelog. Expected: compute semver suggestion from the same visible release-section items used for output.
